desc:
⚔️ TURF WARS ⚔️ 

The field is split down the middle. Every kill steals ground. Push the enemy off the map to win! 💥

🧱 BUILD - Stack blocks into walls, bunkers and cover on your side of the line
🔫 FIGHT - When combat starts, grab your guns. Every kill pushes the line forward
📈 ESCALATE - Kills are worth more points every round, so no lead is ever safe
🏆 CONQUER - Take the whole field to win
🔴🔵 RED vs BLUE - May the winner take it all.

Tons of guns, from pistols to snipers to rocket launchers. Every wall can save you... until a rocket finds it.
Grab your friends and take the win! 🏆
